errors.text: The proposed 'targeted perturbation' is described as restricting sampling to a critical region rather than explicitly using free-energy perturbation based on the MTP–DFT energy difference. Restricting phase space can bias an absolute free-energy calculation and is not equivalent to FEP.
The asserted requirement of more than 10,000 atoms is unsupported and conflicts with the target implementation using a 3456-atom MTP/MD cell; it would also undermine the claimed efficiency gain.
